title: eval-harness: integrate CI prompt-regression gating with metrics exporter and thresholds
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a new CI integration for the eval-harness that enforces prompt-set regression gates based on configurable metric thresholds. Motivation: prevent silent quality regressions when model or prompt changes are merged by failing CI when eval metrics (accuracy, rouge, hallucination-rate) exceed configured thresholds. This PR implements: 1) a GH Actions workflow that runs the eval-harness job and uploads metrics to the new eval-metrics exporter; 2) a lightweight gating hook that compares run metrics to thresholds stored in repo config and fails CI with an actionable message; 3) metric export path and tagging so downstream dashboards can ingest CI runs; 4) tests and a docs page describing how to add new prompt-sets and tune gates. Checklist: - [x] implement CI workflow and hook - [x] metric exporter integration - [x] unit/integration tests - [x] docs and runbook - [x] Linear/Jira links added. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and threshold baselines. This description includes the high-level rationale and rollout notes for SaaS customers running private deployments: gating is off by default for private installs; operators can enable via thresholds_config.yaml.
commits: feat(eval): add prompt-set regression CI hook and metrics exporter
test(ci): add integration test for gating thresholds and failure messages
chore(ci): update GH Actions workflow to include eval-metrics upload and gating step
docs(eval): add ci-integration and runbook for tuning gates
review_comments: Marcus Lee: Quick question on thresholds_config.yaml format: can we support per-prompt-set overrides? I think yes if we use a map keyed by prompt_set_id.
Ava Chen: Good call. thresholds_config.yaml now supports global defaults plus per-prompt-set overrides. Added tests for override behavior.
Dimitri Ivanov: Integration tests are flaky on first run due to timing of metrics upload. Suggest adding retry/backoff for the uploader.
Ava Chen: Added exponential backoff and a small jitter to the exporter upload. Re-ran CI.
Sofia Patel: Approving after verifying the GH Actions flow logs and failure message are actionable. Please squash on merge and include Linear keys in the commit message.
release_notes: Adds eval-harness CI gating for prompt-set regressions. New GH Actions workflow 'eval-harness-ci' will evaluate configured prompt-sets and fail merges that regress beyond configured thresholds. Includes metric exporter and docs. Default behavior is opt-in for private installs.
notes_for_operators: Operators on Redwood Private: enable gating by setting eval_harness.gating.enabled=true and providing thresholds_config.yaml via your config repo. Defaults are conservative; tune thresholds using the runbook in docs/eval/ci-integration.md.
